description: This PHP source file defines the 'Compare' controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce framework. It handles functionalities related to product comparison, including displaying the comparison page, adding products, and removing products from the comparison list. The class interacts with models for products, manufacturers, stock status, and image processing, and manages session data to track the products selected for comparison.

classes.name: Compare
classes.description: Controller class for managing product comparison features in OpenCart, including viewing, adding, and removing products from the comparison list.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the product comparison page, assembling product data, and rendering the comparison view.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to add a product to the comparison list, updates session data, and returns a JSON response.
